description: Validated cookstoves fixture using TJ+NCV path with project fuel derived from stove efficiencies. fNRB on both baseline and project. Year-1 annual ER only.

methodology_notes.headline_metric: net_er_tco2e is year-1 annual tCO2e, not lifetime
methodology_notes.fuel_basis: baseline and project fuel consumption are per household/device
methodology_notes.project_fuel: derived from baseline_efficiency / project_efficiency when project fuel not supplied
methodology_notes.fnrb_application: fNRB applied to both baseline and project (biomass-to-biomass)
methodology_notes.leakage: leakage_factor set to 0 for baseline validation fixture
methodology_notes.adoption_usage: adoption_rate and usage_rate both set to 1.0
